headline.en: Find tool-call contract breaks in saved responses.
headline.zh: 从保存的响应中找出工具调用违约。

sub.en: Invary checks a captured tool call against four explicit invariants and reports the failing evidence locally.
sub.zh: Invary 在本地按四项明确不变量检查捕获的工具调用，并输出失败证据。

body.en: A saved trace and schema are sufficient.
body.zh: 保存的轨迹与 schema 即可运行。

body.en: Each invariant names the violated contract.
body.zh: 每个不变量指出违反的契约。

body.en: Failed checks return a nonzero status.
body.zh: 失败检查返回非零状态。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The script checks two complete bundled synthetic traces and verifies the expected success and rejection exit codes.
note.zh: 脚本检查两份完整随仓合成轨迹，并核验预期的成功与拒绝退出码。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Two bundled synthetic traces checked against the bundled schema. Fixture names are labels, not a live comparison of model providers; an expected schema-drift rejection is included.
steps.output:
trace:   examples/sample_deepseek_output.json
schema:  examples/tool-schema.json
tool:    get_weather
args:    {"location":"Tokyo","unit":"celsius"}

INVARIANT        SEV      STATE  EVIDENCE
valid_json       error    ✓ pass -
required_fields  error    ✓ pass -
arg_types        error    ✓ pass -
no_schema_drift  warn     ✓ pass -

4 pass / 0 fail
command exit: 0
trace:   examples/sample_glm_output.json
schema:  examples/tool-schema.json
tool:    get_weather
args:    {"location":"Tokyo","timezone":"Asia/Tokyo"}

INVARIANT        SEV      STATE  EVIDENCE
valid_json       error    ✓ pass -
required_fields  error    ✓ pass -
arg_types        error    ✓ pass -
no_schema_drift  warn     ✗ FAIL undeclared argument field(s): timezone

3 pass / 1 fail
command exit: 1

body.en: The script checks two complete bundled synthetic traces and verifies the expected success and rejection exit codes.
body.zh: 脚本检查两份完整随仓合成轨迹，并核验预期的成功与拒绝退出码。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/invary.git
cd invary
go build .

limitations.en: check evaluates only the first tool call in a response. It is not a complete JSON Schema implementation.
limitations.zh: check 只检查响应中的第一个工具调用，不是完整 JSON Schema 实现。

limitations.en: run and init remain milestone stubs; this release does not perform a live multi-provider differential run.
limitations.zh: run 和 init 仍为里程碑占位，当前版本不执行在线多提供方差分运行。

limitations.en: Provider names in fixtures identify example files, not measured provider reliability.
limitations.zh: fixture 中的提供方名称只是文件标签，不代表实测可靠性。

body.en: A response can look plausible yet omit a required argument, use the wrong type, or invent a field. A saved response and tool schema make these failures reproducible without another model request.
body.zh: 响应看似合理，也可能缺少必填参数、类型错误或多出字段。保存响应与工具 schema 后，无需再次请求模型即可复现这些问题。

body.en: The CLI loads trace and schema JSON, selects the first tool call, and evaluates valid_json, required_fields, arg_types and no_schema_drift. The report prints evidence per rule. Any failed rule, including a warning-level drift, returns a nonzero exit.
body.zh: CLI 加载轨迹与 schema JSON，选择第一个工具调用，检查 valid_json、required_fields、arg_types 和 no_schema_drift。报告逐规则输出证据；任一失败都会非零退出，包括警告级的字段漂移。

body.en: The CLI loads trace and schema JSON, selects the first tool call, and evaluates valid_json, required_fields, arg_types and no_schema_drift. The report prints evidence per rule. Any failed rule, including a warning-level drift, returns a nonzero exit.
body.zh: CLI 加载轨迹与 schema JSON，选择第一个工具调用，检查 valid_json、required_fields、arg_types 和 no_schema_drift。报告逐规则输出证据；任一失败都会非零退出，包括警告级的字段漂移。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: --trace and --schema are required for check. The four rules are built in and no API key or configuration file is needed. Warn severity affects triage; it does not make a failed rule pass the gate.
body.zh: check 必须提供 --trace 和 --schema。四条规则内置，无需 API 密钥或配置文件。warn 级别用于分诊，不会让失败规则通过门禁。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
go run . check --trace examples/sample_deepseek_output.json --schema examples/tool-schema.json
go run . check --trace examples/sample_glm_output.json --schema examples/tool-schema.json
